notes: 25 candidates: 5 program-list, 0 single-record, 20 not-a-list. Columbia GSB per-year dissertation pages (2013, 2014) list all-area business school dissertations with authors and advisors; the year selector shows 1998-2016, so sibling year pages are likely equally useful. The Columbia dissertations_for_crawlers page has titles only and duplicates the per-year content without names. The Columbia job-market page lists 2016 candidates (incl. two DRO) without placements. The HEC Paris placements page gives named first academic placements for the 2012-13 to 2014-15 job market seasons with area labels (Operations Management: Timofey Shalpegin -> University of Auckland; Mahyar Eftekhar -> Arizona State), marks post-docs explicitly, and states it covers academic placements only; earlier years are listed by institution without names. The ISB FPM job-market page names a single finance candidate. The IE host page is a European Accounting Association event site hosted by IE, not an IE program page. No institution-by-host corrections needed.
